context: Mei and Aoi chat about a canceled plan.
purpose: Casual register hitting everyday stragglers (だって/つもり/残念/もらう/おく) naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 明日の映画、行くつもりだったの。
lines.en: I was planning to go to the movie tomorrow.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle slightly disappointed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えっ、行けなくなったの?残念!
lines.en: Huh, you can't go anymore? That's a shame!
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm sympathetic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、だって急に仕事が入って。
lines.en: Yeah, because work suddenly came up.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm rueful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: チケット、誰かにもらってもらう?
lines.en: Should you have someone take the ticket?
lines.style: helpful barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 友達にもらってもらうつもりなの。
lines.en: I plan to have a friend take it.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 次は、早めに予約しておこうね。
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm encouraging delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうね、今度はおくびに出さず計画するわ。
lines.en: Right, next time I'll plan quietly.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm resolved delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 残念だけど、また誘ってね!
lines.en: It's a shame, but invite me again!
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm bubbly delivery throughout
